verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot's Cloud agent (coding agent) lets developers assign tasks that plan, explore, and execute autonomously in isolated cloud sandboxes, with scheduling/automation, a control plane to track multiple agent sessions, and review/merge workflow, well documented in first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence/community corroboration of the cloud agent specifically (community citations predate this feature and cover other aspects), and no third-party benchmarking of isolation/security guarantees.
